children: Axon Enterprise entered into a second amendment to its Credit Agreement, increasing its revolving credit facility from $300 million to $500 million and permitting a $150 million accordion. The amendment, expected to become effective alongside the company’s 0% Convertible Notes due 2031 offering, also extends the maturity to up to five years from closing, expected to be Sept. 18, 2031, subject to certain earlier maturity triggers. Borrowings will bear interest at SOFR plus 1.25% to 1.75% based on net leverage, with a 0.15% commitment fee on unused commitments. The update is intended to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility while accommodating the planned notes offering.
: Second amendment to revolving credit facility ($500 million, $150 million accordion)
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Up to 5 years from closing (expected to Sep 18 2031)
: Increase liquidity, extend maturity, and permit 2031 convertible notes
